jobs.occupation: Customer Support Advisor: English + German + 1 other European Language
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.

- Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns.
- Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved.
- Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance.
- Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure.
- Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support.
- Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences.

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language.
- You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations.
- Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts.
- You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed.
- Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends.
- A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset.
- Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved.

• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support.

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language. 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed.

Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

The position is Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work during particularly busy periods.

You will work in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

Flexibility regarding working hours is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge & experience

 
• 
Very good English – essential for the position.

 
• 
Good knowledge of German.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Dutch.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in administration, customer service or case management is a strong asset.

 
• 
Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

 
• 
No specific experience is required, as full training will be provided.

Skills & personality

 
• 
Excellent telephone communication skills.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
• 
Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

 
• 
Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

 
• 
Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Flexible and quick to adapt to new tools, procedures and situations.

 
• 
Reliable, motivated and eager to learn.

jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Representative (English + East EU language)
jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you are responsible for providing excellent service and commercial support to customers in a specific region: Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe. You work hand in hand with the External Sales Representative and help strengthen customer relationships, drive sales growth, and promote the use of our digital tools. 

Key responsibilities:
 
 

• Open new customer accounts (approx. 30%) and grow business with existing customers (approx. 70%) 

• Prepare accurate offers and price calculations 

• Enter and follow up on orders 

• Actively manage your accounts via phone and email, with a focus on cross-selling and digital migration 

• Maintain and update customer data in the internal system 

• Understand customer needs, market context, product applications, and competitors 

• Be the main point of contact for customer inquiries, complaints, and support 

• Identify and close commercial opportunities 

• Report on sales projects and progress in close collaboration with External Sales 

• Contribute to the team with flexibility and a hands-on attitude 
 

• You have a technical and/or commercial background 

• You have at least 4 years of B2B sales experience, preferably with technical products 

• You are fluent in English (spoken and written) – mandatory 

• Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong asset 

• French and/or Arabic is an asset 

• Strong skills in Excel and general IT tools 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• You are proactive, persuasive, structured, and a true team player 

• Able to multitask and work under pressure in a small but ambitious team

This Assistant role provides wide-ranging administrative, communication, and coordination support to a sector group manager within a major European industry association. The position is ideal for a proactive professional who enjoys autonomy, stakeholder interaction, and managing diverse projects simultaneously.

 

Client Details

 The hiring organisation is a well-established European association representing companies across a specialised industrial sector. It plays a central role in supporting its members through major green, digital, and regulatory transformations, working closely with EU institutions, businesses, and expert groups. The association leads strategic initiatives, facilitates knowledge exchange, and supports long-term industry competitiveness and sustainability.

 

Description

• Provide day‑to‑day support to the team manager.
• Track selected policy topics and assist in preparing brief inputs.
• Organise physical and virtual meetings, including agendas and follow‑up.
• Handle travel planning and event logistics.
• Coordinate activities of working groups.
• Draft short reports and communication summaries.
• Update webpages, newsletters, and social media posts.
• Maintain contact lists, files, and member resources.
 

 

•  Degree in Office Management or similar,
• Relevant assistant experience is a must.
• Strong communication skills in English; other languages are a big plus.
• Confident with digital tools, websites, and social media.
• Skilled in Microsoft Office and collaborative platforms.
• Highly organised with strong prioritisation abilities.
• Comfortable interacting with diverse stakeholders.
• Proactive, solution‑oriented, and able to work independently.
• Calm and reliable under time pressure.

You will manage the entire order process, from design and quotation through to production, delivery, and after-sales follow-up.

 

Client Details

Our partner is part of an international company operating in the retail industry. To strengthen their Sales Support team, they are looking for a German-speaking Sales Support Specialist to assist both Account Managers and customers throughout their projects.

You will join a dynamic and sustainable work environment where growth, collaboration, and respect are at the heart of the company culture. Thanks to a structured onboarding program, you will quickly get up to speed and become a valued member of the team from day one.

Description

What will you do?

• You will work closely with our distributor network & managing projects.
• You will advise customers on the best solutions.
• Throughout each project, you will build and maintain strong commercial relationships with your customers.
• You will manage the entire order process, from design and quotation through to production, delivery, and after-sales follow-up.
• You will communicate daily with customers and suppliers to ensure orders are completed accurately and on time.
• You will handle customer complaints professionally by investigating issues and implementing appropriate solutions, working closely with the Account Manager when needed.
• You will monitor backorders and process product returns accurately and efficiently.
• You will ensure accurate invoicing, prepare credit notes, and follow up on outstanding payments.

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who:

• Has a strong customer focus and is passionate about delivering excellent service.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys learning new skills.
• Takes initiative and enjoys working on a variety of projects.
• Is organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities efficiently.
• Has a positive attitude and enjoys collaborating as part of a team.
• Has a hands-on mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
• Is fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch is a strong advantage.
• Is proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
The Commercial Coordinator role within the FMCG industry focuses on supporting sales, logistics, customer service operations in the beer sector. This position requires organisational skills to manage customer interactions and ensure smooth process optimizations.

Client Details

Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.

They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Description

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.

 

Concretely you will:

 

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process
 

 

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
• Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
• Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.
 

Receiving Operations:

• Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
• Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
• Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
• Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
• Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
• Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.
 

Continuous Improvement:

• Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
• Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
• Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
• Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.
 

Driver Reception Desk:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
• Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
• Provide drivers with all required documentation.
• Perform administrative tasks.
• Print locator labels and tickets.
• Resolve operational issues and exceptions.
 

Outbound (Backup Support):

• Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
• Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
• Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
• Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
• Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
• Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
• Strong communication skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Continuous improvement mentality.
• Team player.
• Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
• Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

A key player in European manufacturing, uniting over 180 stakeholders from 20 countries. Committed to innovation, it strives to enhance resource efficiency in large-scale value chain productions across diverse sectors.

Jobomschrijving

Primary responsibilities project management support (50%):
	
• Creating timelines and contributing to effective planning of funded project activities.	
• Monitoring budgets of EU-funded projects and tracking team members’ time dedication consistently, systematically, and coherently.	
• Supporting team members in completing tasks, drafting, and submitting reports.	
• Oversee and implement the communication and dissemination tasks of projects.	
• Support organising conferences, events, meetings, and other activities linked to projects.	
• Providing communication support to Processes4Planet projects.

Communications activities and providing value to members (50%)
	
• Create a yearly Communication Plan and track its implementation,	
• Manage and enhance the Association’s external communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, etc.), 	
• Operate members-only collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint),	
• Manage internal communication with company members by operating the existing tools or suggesting new ideas.	
• Generate and write content for social media, news releases, newsletters, bulletins, etc.	
• Prepare presentations and small publications and manage relations with providers.	
• Support to facilitate networking activities 	
• Organiseparticipation in external conferences, and support with organization of internal events (conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.).

Qualifications and experience:
	
• Degree in project management, communications, public relations, business administration or related studies.	
• Minimum 3 years of experience in positions dealing with the tasks described for this position, with excellent performance.	
• Experience with EU funds is an asset.

Your key skills:
	
• An energetic person with a hands-on approach, task-oriented with attention to detail	
• Team player with a cooperative spirit	
• Ability to work in a small core team and diverse virtual teams with people across organizational boundaries and several countries/regions.	
• Outstanding organisation and prioritization skills with a capacity to retro plan and fulfil strict deadlines.	
• High-quality results and output oriented.	
• Capacity to work with complexity and to juggle a variety of tasks flexibly and proactively.	
• Creative problem-solving skills, able to anticipate needs and deliver your work autonomously
Technical skills and languages:
	
• Strong skills in Word, PowerPoint, Excel and collaborative online tools (e.g. SharePoint).	
• Experience in project management.	
• Excellent spoken and written English. Other languages are an asset.
